lines.say: In twenty eleven, Netflix lost eight hundred thousand customers in one quarter.
The ten dollar plan had turned into about sixteen dollars, for the same two things.
Then the CEO wrote a note that started, I messed up. I owe everyone an explanation.
Regulars react the same way to a price change. They won't say a word, they just wait longer between cuts, then stop.
Tell them first. Heads up, cuts go up five dollars in January. Book this week for the old price.
Comment KEEP and we'll show you who's gone quiet.
